description: Accountability keeps you in control of your own life #accountability #selfmastery #DesignYourLife
transcript: I address myself before addressing the external world. I am always willing to follow my own sword, and that keeps me accountable. With accountability, that keeps me in full control of myself and my internal world. I don't go looking for validation or try to prove any points because none of that matters. Accountability keeps my hands on the wheel. Accountability keeps me in alignment and keeps me structured. There are rules to follow, and it is important to make rules for yourself, not for others. You have to stay in alignment for yourself.
